summary: News Corp filed an 8-K regarding its stock repurchase program, which authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate repurchases of Class A and Class B common stock. The filing discloses daily transaction notices provided to the Australian Securities Exchange under ASX rules, with exhibits attached. No price/share, premium, or specific timeline is given; the program is open-ended and conducted from time to time. The board has previously authorized the program, and the company continues to execute it subject to market conditions. Watch for ongoing repurchase activity and potential volume impact on stock float.
